build: python3 -c "from lib import materials; materials.build()"  (run from src/)
conventions: RGBA 8-bit straight alpha; swatches flat-lit and seamlessly tileable (period = image size); palette per ART_DIRECTION.md

files.description: Crushed terracotta velvet (banquette of cabin_interior.png): photographic fine pile band, periodic procedural crush/sheen, colour response of the real fabric (shadow -> oxblood, sheen -> orange). Flat-lit, seamless.
files.suggested_use: Clip into cabin banquette / cushion shapes (collage 02); multiply a terracotta->oxblood gradient on top for depth.

files.description: Fluted / slatted oak wall from cabin_interior.png: grooves rectified to exactly 50 px pitch (perfectly vertical), every flute phase normalised to the wall-average profile (evenly lit), assembled from whole real slats, golden-oak grade.
files.suggested_use: Clip into the arched cabin shells / bar counter front; scale so pitch matches the drawing; keep vertical. Add a soft vertical light falloff per plane in the collage.

files.description: Warm-white polished marble with the cabin table character: gold-ochre veins with bleed, fine grey crackle network and nests, pepper flecks, clouding. Procedural (colours sampled from the table top), crisp at any scale, seamless.
Back-lit honey linen festoon swags (ceiling_lookup_A.png): swag columns rectified to 400 px, glow gradients flattened, lattice-quilted so seams run along gather lines.
files.suggested_use: Ceiling draping planes (both collages): perspective-warp onto ceiling quads; screen/soft-light a honey glow on top.

files.description: Ivory plain-weave linen (procedural): slubbed yarns, per-thread tone, wandering threads, fibre fuzz, very soft cloth undulation. Thread pitch 5 px. Flat-lit, seamless.
files.suggested_use: Sheer / blind / curtain planes, label cards, base for translucent overlays (multiply or soft light at low opacity over photos for a linen-print feel).

files.description: Warm lime plaster (wall under festoon_valance.png): real fine detail (scratches, pits, trowel grain) quilted, cloudy limewash mottle procedural, sand/plaster colour. Seamless.
files.suggested_use: Wall planes, void drum, background card planes.

files.description: 3 x 3 mosaic of real wavy glass blocks from glassblock_wall_A.png, re-gridded on the mortar: every block resampled to its cell, equal 18 px joints, mortar tone equalised; repeats exactly on the mortar grid.
files.suggested_use: Glass-brick facade / screen (collage 01 facade, collage 02 edge screen). Tile with an offset that keeps mortar lines on the grid; overlay dusk/amber gradients in soft light.

files.description: Brushed stainless steel (procedural): horizontal grain at 3 scales, sparse scratches, broad satin bands, cool steel colour. Seamless.
files.suggested_use: Void rail ring, bar details, pendants; rotate to follow the rail direction.

files.description: Polished cream terrazzo (procedural): cream cement matrix with fine coloured sand, chips in 4 size classes (terracotta, sage, ochre, warm/dark grey, white marble) with internal mottle and cut-edge rims, faint polish. Seamless.
files.suggested_use: Floors (perspective warp), sills, table bases, swatch cards.

files.description: RGBA foliage overlay: the void tree canopy keyed off the skylight (void_lookup_B.png), violet fringe removed, edge colour decontaminated, quilted in premultiplied RGBA. Transparent where sky. Seamless.
files.suggested_use: Canopy fill / leafy overlays around the tree (collage 01), shadow-play (fill black at low opacity), planters.

files.description: Warm linen paper ground #EEE5D3: smooth large mottling, faint felt tooth, sparse fine fibres; low-entropy (no per-pixel noise). paper_linen(3508, 4961, seed=1).
files.suggested_use: Bottom paper layer of both collages.

files.description: Neutral film grain, mean 0.5 (128), std 0.05; fine 0.6 px + clumped 1.4 px grain. grain(3508, 4961, seed=2, amount=0.05).
files.suggested_use: Top layer, blend overlay or soft light at 30-60 %.

files.description: Client mood reference (client_drape_reference.png, 380x470, white border cropped to 368x461) upscaled 6x: NL-means denoise, 2-stage Lanczos, bilateral de-ringing, gentle unsharp, imperceptible grain. LOW SOURCE RES: it stays soft - use as a soft/overlay/background element only, never as a sharp foreground.
Sheer veil from the client drape: lightened, mostly desaturated toward linen, alpha from luminance (0.10..0.82: bright fabric opaque, shadowed folds transparent).
files.suggested_use: Translucent sheer-linen overlay (normal or screen) over diners / windows.

functions.paper_linen(h, w, seed, color, mottle, f: warm linen paper RGB, low-entropy, tileable
functions.grain(h, w, seed, amount): neutral mid-grey film grain (h, w) for overlay / soft light
functions.torn_mask(mask, seed, roughness, scale): torn-paper edge for any mask -> float mask
functions.deckle_rgba(mask, seed, width, color, fi: white fibrous torn-edge strip RGBA layer
functions.paper_cut_edge(mask, light, width, stren: bevel / lit cut edge RGBA for card planes
functions.upscale_soft(img, s): denoise + Lanczos + de-ring + gentle sharpen upscale
functions.key_foliage(im): key leaves off bright sky with fringe removal + edge decontamination
